system.name: HILOS
system.one_liner: a near-storage-processing framework that boosts offline LLM inference throughput by offloading attention to SmartSSD accelerators

components.name: User
components.role: customizes HLS source code and benchmark configuration

components.name: HLS Codes
components.role: high-level synthesis source implementing (customized) attention variants

components.name: C/C++ Simulator (lm_eval_harness)
components.role: simulation and verification tool validating accelerator functional correctness on standard LLM benchmarks before synthesis

components.name: Performance Estimator
components.role: predicts hardware throughput from HLS-obtained cycle counts and clock frequency

components.name: Writeback Manager
components.role: manages delayed KV cache writeback to storage, hiding write latency and mitigating write amplification

components.name: Weights Prefetcher
components.role: stages model weights from host to GPU

components.name: Inference Controller
components.role: directs core LLM operations (e.g., MLP, QKV) during runtime

components.name: Cache Scheduler
components.role: determines the optimal X-cache ratio, partitions the KV cache between SmartSSDs and the GPU during prefill, and coordinates parallel execution

components.name: Vitis Compiler
components.role: compiles validated HLS source into a hardware design

components.name: Bitstream Generator
components.role: produces the FPGA bitstream deployed to the SmartSSDs

components.name: System Interconnect
components.role: links the middleware to the SmartSSD array via Storage I/O, cuFile I/O, OpenCL API and XRT API

components.name: SmartSSD
components.role: near-storage device with a PCIe switch, SSD controller, FPGA logic, FPGA DRAM and NAND running the attention accelerator

flows.what: customized high-level synthesis source for specialized attention variants

content.key_idea: HILOS provides a full design flow from user-customizable HLS attention kernels, through simulation/verification and performance estimation, to a middleware layer (writeback manager, prefetcher, controller, cache scheduler) that orchestrates a replicated array of SmartSSD near-storage accelerators.

summary: HILOS is a ready-to-use near-storage-processing framework that boosts offline LLM inference throughput by offloading attention computation to SmartSSD accelerators. This figure gives HILOS's full-system overview in three horizontal layers. The User-Level layer (top) shows the design flow: a user customizes HLS attention kernels and LLM configuration, which a C/C++ simulator integrated with lm-evaluation-harness verifies functionally before a Performance Estimator predicts hardware throughput from HLS cycle counts. The Middleware layer (middle) orchestrates runtime inference: an Inference Controller directs core LLM operations while a Weights Prefetcher stages weights, a Cache Scheduler partitions the KV cache between SmartSSDs and the GPU via an X-cache ratio, and a Writeback Manager delays KV cache writeback; a Vitis Compiler and Bitstream Generator handle the hardware build path. The bottom layer shows the replicated SmartSSD hardware (PCIe switch, SSD controller, FPGA logic/DRAM, NAND) reached through a shared System Interconnect exposing Storage I/O, cuFile I/O, OpenCL and XRT APIs. Green fill highlights the components that are HILOS's own contributions.
summary_zh: 该图展示HILOS整体框架：用户层完成HLS注意力代码定制、经lm-evaluation-harness仿真验证并由性能估计器预测吞吐；中间件层的推理控制器、权重预取器、缓存调度器（按X-cache比例在SmartSSD与GPU间划分KV缓存）和回写管理器协调运行；底层为通过统一接口连接的多块SmartSSD近存储硬件，绿色标出HILOS自身的新增组件。
